title: Transcript Settings Persistence
requirements: Persist TranscriptSettings (useOnDeviceSpeech, useWhisperFallback) to UserDefaults using a dedicated prefix key (e.g. "transcription.useOnDeviceSpeech")
SettingsViewModel.transcriptionSettings initializer reads from UserDefaults, falling back to defaults; defaults match the prior struct initializer defaults
Add a save() / commit handler on SettingsViewModel that writes toggles to UserDefaults on change or on Save (deterministic; no partial persistence)
Keep API-key persistence in Keychain (not UserDefaults); Keychain + UserDefaults writes must not interleave inconsistently
acceptance_criteria: Toggle useOnDeviceSpeech or useWhisperFallback, restart the app, verify the toggle holds
A fresh installation with no UserDefaults sees default TranscriptSettings values
API key (Keychain) and toggles (UserDefaults) persist independently and survive restart
